access_tokens.create.description: Create a short-lived access token for Whop web and mobile embedded components. Maps to WHOP_CREATE_ACCESS_TOKEN. Official POST /access_tokens uses account_id; Composio sends company_id. Provide user_id or company/account id with an API key.

account_id.description: Company/account identifier (biz_*). Official query name on Current API list endpoints.

company_id.description: Company identifier (biz_*). Composio company_id; official list filters also accept account_id.

expires_at.description: Token expiration timestamp in ISO 8601 format (defaults to 1 hour, max 3 hours).

scoped_actions.description: Permission scopes to grant. Must be a subset of the credential's permissions.

user_id.description: User identifier (user_*). Cannot be used together with company_id/account_id.

access_tokens.create.title: Create access token

accounts.get.description: Retrieve a Whop account/company by ID, route, or me. Maps to Composio WHOP_RETRIEVE_COMPANY (GET /accounts/{id}; id may be me).
accounts.get.title: Get account

accounts.list.description: List Whop accounts visible to the credential.
accounts.list.title: List accounts

apps.get.description: Retrieve the details of an existing Whop app by id. Maps to WHOP_RETRIEVE_APP.

id.description: The unique identifier of the app to retrieve.

apps.get.title: Retrieve app

apps.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of apps on the Whop platform. Maps to WHOP_LIST_APPS.

account_id.description: Company/account identifier (biz_*). Official query name on Current API list endpoints.

after.description: Returns the elements in the list that come after the specified cursor.

before.description: Returns the elements in the list that come before the specified cursor.

company_id.description: Company identifier (biz_*). Composio company_id; official list filters also accept account_id.

first.description: Returns the first n elements from the list.

last.description: Returns the last n elements from the list.

query.description: A search string to filter apps by name.

verified_apps_only.description: Whether to only return apps that have been verified by Whop.

apps.list.title: List apps

filename.description: The name of the file including its extension (e.g., photo.png).

plans.update.description: Update a plan's pricing, billing interval, visibility, stock, and other settings. Maps to WHOP_UPDATE_PLAN. Compatibility PATCH /plans/{id} for the variants resource.

billing_period.description: The number of days between recurring charges (e.g., 30 for monthly).

custom_fields.description: Custom field definitions collected at checkout.

description.description: A text description of the plan displayed to customers.

expiration_days.description: Days until the membership expires; omit for no expiration.

id.description: The unique identifier of the plan to update (plan_*).

initial_price.description: The amount charged on the first purchase, in the plan's currency.

offer_cancel_discount.description: Whether to offer a retention discount when a customer cancels.

payment_method_configuration.description: Payment method configuration for the plan.

renewal_price.description: The amount charged each billing period for recurring plans.

stock.description: The maximum number of units available for purchase.

strike_through_initial_price.description: Comparison price with strikethrough for the initial charge.

strike_through_renewal_price.description: Comparison price with strikethrough for the renewal charge.

title.description: The display name of the plan shown to customers.

trial_period_days.description: Free trial days before the first charge on a recurring plan.

unlimited_stock.description: When true, the stock field is ignored and availability is unlimited.
